# StorageDump

> StorageDump is a free, open-source Chrome extension that inspects and exports everything a website stores in your browser — cookies (including HttpOnly and partitioned), localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, Cache Storage and service workers — as lossless JSON or ZIP, entirely on your machine.

Version 0.2.1, MIT license. On-demand only: no server, no analytics, no background reads. Exports are saved to the Downloads folder.

## What it does

- One panel for 7 storage types: cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, Cache Storage, Service Workers, extension storage.
- Reads all frames, including cross-origin iframes.
- IndexedDB drill-down preserving Map, Set, BigInt and cyclic values.
- Cache bodies exported as text, or base64 for binary when "Skip binary bodies" is off.
- JSON or ZIP export with manifest, large-file splitting and optional masking of sensitive values.
- Edit/delete entries; export history with SHA-256 checksums.

## Install

- Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/storagedump/kihoghfekemdccfnpjefmggehpgnjnab
- From source: `npm install`, `npm run build`, then load `dist/` unpacked at chrome://extensions (Developer mode).

## Use

Click the toolbar icon, press Scan, then Export all or Open dashboard.
